title: News: why a US inflation number moves crypto

linkedin.text:
Tomorrow at 1:30 PM Lagos time, the US publishes its inflation number for September (CPI).

If you hold crypto, or plan to, this one number can move your portfolio more than most crypto news this week. Here is the chain, in plain words:

1. Inflation comes in high.
2. The US central bank keeps interest rates high for longer.
3. Safe government bonds keep paying more.
4. Some money leaves risky assets like crypto for that safer return.

It works in reverse too. A cooler number can mean more money flowing back into risk.

The forecast is 3.6% a year, up from 3.4% last month (CoinDesk's calendar). Markets often move on the gap between the forecast and the real number, not the number itself.

You don't need to trade on it. Just know why prices might jump around tomorrow afternoon, so a red candle doesn't scare you into a bad decision.

Education, not financial advice.
